title_en: Cooking Chinese Dishes (9/20): Lanzhou Hand-Pulled Noodles
note_en: 越……越…… means "the more... the more...": 越细的面条煮的时间就越短 "the thinner the noodles, the shorter the cooking time." Each 越 goes right before the adjective that changes, and 就 can be added before the second 越. The text even chains a third part with 也越: 口感也越爽滑 "and the smoother they feel."
